title: Camp Pendleton Fire Department and Interagency Partners Combat the Ongoing “Henderson Fire”
description: Members of the Camp Pendleton Fire Department and partnering agencies respond to “Henderson Fire,” at Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton, California, Oct. 17, 2026. The Camp Pendleton Fire Department, supported by air and ground units from CAL FIRE and other agencies, responded to the scene and conducted firefighting operations throughout the morning. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Ana Kalajzic)
